source_pack.description: Multi-source input bundle when more than one article is used

core_claim.description: Primary claim the article wants the audience to believe

source_priority.description: Ordered source IDs showing which source dominates the storyline

cross_source_overlap.description: Claims repeated across sources that should be merged rather than repeated

hard_evidence.description: Evidence points that support the main claim

must_keep_evidence.description: Source details that should survive into the script because they are the strongest factual anchors.

speakable_facts.description: Facts suitable for direct spoken delivery without overloading the listener.

visual_only_details.description: Details that should usually move to cards, charts, captions, or source-image segments instead of spoken lines.

promo_phrases_to_neutralize.description: Source phrases or likely script phrases that should be rewritten into a more evidence-first tone.

commentary_claim_boundaries.description: Boundaries for interpretation so the commentary does not outrun the source evidence.

industry_meaning.description: Why this matters for the industry, market, or research field

public_meaning.description: Why this matters for a general audience

uncertainties.description: Unresolved questions, missing proof, or caveats

counterpoints.description: Counterpoints or balancing views to prevent hollow reporting

spoken_translation_notes.description: Guidance for translating dense source prose into natural spoken commentary.

series_angle.description: How this episode fits into the broader recurring show angle
